notes: Official current source inventory includes REST DELETE rows under the captain policy addendum; existing GitHub issue count tables were preserved and are not treated as implemented counts.
All non-executable rows are blocked operation-ledger rows, not blanket unsafe exclusions.
REST latest resource-page examples are inventoried as documented operations; owner-scoped Metafield routes are included rather than collapsed into one representative owner.
operations.json is intentionally omitted in this connector-local slice because non-executable operation rows live in api_surface.json and fixed GraphQL documents are not fabricated.

State-destroying destroy/remove/cancel/close/disable/revoke/archive/deactivate/uninstall/erasure/expire/void/dispose/release/detach/leave/unlink/disassociate/unpublish/debit operation rows, plus source-documented update/set/toggle/assignment/upsert/replacement side effects that remove pricing, publication, checkout, media, bundle, catalog-context, selling-plan relationships, customer list entries, collection sources/images, market conditions, product option values, subscription plans, discount requirements, dispute evidence files, metaobject fields, attribution icons, media errors, server-pixel subscriptions, inventory locations, payment or delivery customizations, delivery-promise participants, marketing activity information, cash-drawer assignments, product-list entries, standalone/default variants, or active feedback entries, are classified as destructive_action with critical risk and `confirm: destructive`; discountCodeActivate, fulfillmentOrderHold, inventoryTransferSetItems, fileCreate, orderUpdate, collectionReorderProducts, and shippingLabelPurchase remain non-destructive admin_reverse_etl.

Source-deprecated GraphQL rows are marked `deprecated` when non-destructive, while deprecated rows that also remove state preserve `destructive_action` critical risk and `confirm: destructive` with deprecation notes.
